responsibility.value: Pure, stateless calculation of what a rental currently owes — full-month billing for active/completed rentals, prorated daily billing for early returns — and writes the result onto an outbound DTO.

Owns: The billing formula itself: 30-day billing cycle, ceiling-based day/month rounding, daily-rate proration for ReturnedEarly, cap of prorated total at one full month's fee
Null-billing rule for rentals that were never picked up or are in a non-billing-eligible status
doesNotOwn: Persistence — this is a pure static function, no side effects beyond mutating the passed-in DTO
Determining billing eligibility per status — delegated to InstrumentRentalStatus.IsBillingEligible()
Currency/rounding policy beyond decimal.Round(x, 2) — no explicit currency type or locale handling

collaborators.detail: Reads Fee, PickedUpAt, ReturnedAt, RentalStatus — does not mutate the entity
Mutates the DTO in place: Fee, MonthsCharged, DaysCharged, DailyFee, IsProrated, TotalFee
IsBillingEligible() gate and a direct == ReturnedEarly check to pick the proration branch

contracts: A rental with no PickedUpAt, or a status that IsBillingEligible() rejects, always produces all-null billing fields and IsProrated=false.
daysCharged and monthsCharged are never less than 1 once a rental has been picked up and is billing-eligible, even if the elapsed time is under a day/month.
For ReturnedEarly, TotalFee is capped at the full monthly fee — proration can never charge more than a normal full-term rental would.
end is clamped to never be earlier than start (end < start is corrected to end = start), so a corrupted ReturnedAt earlier than PickedUpAt cannot produce a negative charge.
assumptions: rental.Fee already reflects the correct monthly rate for the instrument at time of pickup — this function does not look up or validate the fee against InstrumentType.MonthlyFee.
nowUtc is only used when ReturnedAt is null (an in-progress rental); callers are expected to pass a consistent UTC clock value (typically IClock.UtcNow).
invariants: The function is pure — same inputs always produce the same BillingResult, no reliance on ambient state.
failureModes: None thrown — all edge cases (not picked up, ineligible status, end before start, sub-day/sub-month duration) are handled by returning null fields or clamping rather than throwing.
architecturalNotes: Static class / static method by design — appropriate for a pure calculation with no dependencies, but means it cannot be mocked in tests; callers (RentalCommandService, RentalQueryService, ReportService) call it directly.
BillingResult is a private readonly record struct — an implementation detail not exposed outside this class.
